title: [bundle] Fix audit-found prompt-hub fail-open gap: `hf prompt-hub vib
objective: Fix audit-found prompt-hub fail-open gap: `hf prompt-hub vibe --definitely-unsupported-flag` and `hf prompt-hub vibe --scope` currently exit 0 and mint task/bundle artifacts instead of rejecting malformed input. Make prompt-hub reject unsupported flags and missing flag values before side effects, preserving supported `hf prompt-hub "<vibe>" [--scope glob,glob] [--dispatch] [--json]`. Add CLI regressions proving unsupported/malformed prompt-hub args exit nonzero and create no files in an empty temp repo, while supported non-dispatch prompt-hub still mints as expected.
acceptance_criteria: hf prompt-hub rejects unsupported flags before minting task or bundle artifacts.
hf prompt-hub rejects --scope without a value before minting task or bundle artifacts.
Regression coverage proves malformed prompt-hub args exit nonzero and create no files in an empty temp repo.
Supported hf prompt-hub "<vibe>" [--scope glob,glob] [--dispatch] [--json] behavior is preserved.
